name: American Steel Fabrication
old_description: Locally owned and operated, American Steel Fabrication is a hands-on subcontractor big enough to handle large projects across the Midwest and small enough to take care of each customer and the inevitable details that follow every project. Having been in business for over 27 years, The ASFI Community is stronger than ever. We pride ourselves on having the best clients in the business, providing a quality product at competitive prices in a fast, friendly and flexible way. President Tim Thomas understands the needs of both clients and contractors and delivers quality workmanship every time. A premier member of the American Subcontractors Association, Midwest Council, American Steel Fabrication has a stellar reputation for unmatched experience and performance.
about:
American Steel Fabrication was founded in 1994 by Tim Thomas and a group of his customers in Pevely, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis. The company remains locally owned and operated, with Thomas serving as president and drawing on experience that began in the steel construction industry at age 15.

The firm runs a complete fabrication facility supplying both structural and reinforcing steel. It stocks carbon, stainless, and aluminum products in forms including beams, angles, channels, pipe, tube, plate, bar, and sheet, while also fabricating embeds, pipe bollards, adjustable columns, H-pile, joist and deck, and epoxy-coated rebar. Services extend to same-day pickup, next-day delivery, and on-site ironworker erection and installation.

Customers span commercial, industrial, and infrastructure construction across the Midwest. A notable project includes the Ameren Bagnell Dam stabilization, where the company contributed to a 2,453-foot gravity dam requiring 67 post-tension anchors and 17,000 cubic yards of concrete. The client base includes general contractors, subcontractors, and owners such as utility provider Ameren.

Thomas’s background in estimating, accounting, and field operations shapes a culture described as fast, flexible, and friendly. Membership in the American Subcontractors Association Midwest Council and leadership roles in the Steel Institute and Concrete Council reflect a commitment to industry standards and relationships.
